descriptions.listCountries: Lists active countries. Inactive countries are excluded.
descriptions.getCountry: Returns an active country. Inactive countries are treated as not found.
descriptions.listCountryStates: Lists states for an active country in ascending ID order. Inactive countries are treated as not found.
descriptions.listSatMeasurementUnits: Returns measurement units in ascending ID order, including timestamps in the America/Monterrey time zone.
descriptions.listSatKeyOfProductsAndServices: Returns product and service keys in ascending ID order, including timestamps in the America/Monterrey time zone.
